customer_inquiry: Does your webhook payload include retry timestamps when our endpoint returns 500?
agent_reply: Great question! Yes—every webhook delivery includes an `X-Retry-Attempt` and `X-First-Attempt-Timestamp` header, with automatic exponential backoff over 24 hours. You can inspect full delivery logs inside Developers > Webhooks.

customer_inquiry: What is the maximum file upload size on the Pro plan?
agent_reply: On the Pro plan, you can upload individual files up to 250 MB, with up to 500 GB of total workspace storage. If you're working with larger archives, you can also connect an external S3 bucket under Settings > Storage.

Our CSV import fails with error code E-402 on UTF-8 files.
agent_reply: I'm sorry you're running into error E-402 during import! That error occurs when a CSV includes a UTF-8 BOM header or smart quotes in column names. Re-saving the file as standard UTF-8 (without BOM) and ensuring headers use plain ASCII characters will resolve it right away.

customer_inquiry: Can we set role-based permissions for external contractors?
agent_reply: Yes! On Business and Enterprise plans, you can invite external collaborators with the 'Scoped Contributor' role under Team > Roles, restricting access to specific projects while hiding billing and workspace settings.

customer_inquiry: My dashboard charts aren't updating after connecting Firebase.
agent_reply: Thanks for flagging that! After linking Firebase, initial historical sync takes up to 10 minutes. Try refreshing after 10 minutes; if metrics still haven't populated, verify that read permissions are enabled on your target collection under Integrations > Firebase.
